items: Correct earlier rounds: edit bids, tricks, Bomb and Cloud of any finished round; totals are recalculated automatically.
New house rule: the bids in the first round may add up to the hand size.
Rebuilt multi-phone play: instant host discovery, automatic reconnect after screen lock, clear feedback for guests, and seat/name arrangement by the host in the lobby.
Multi-phone sessions end cleanly when the game is finished; guests keep the final scoreboard.
Update notice when a new version is available in the App Store, and a way to rate the app in Settings.
